ValidationRule.description: Ensures that only users in IME and IMAP Divisions can select the Customer Service option from the 'Related To' picklists.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(IM_Division__c,"IME"),ISPICKVAL( IM_Division__c,"IMAP"))),ISPICKVAL(Related_To__c,"Service Cloud (Intl only)"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The 'Related To' value 'Service Cloud (Intl only)' is only available for IME and IMAP users.
